text: 你瞥见一旁有处小小的地质构造，便把诺曼拉到后面躲好。哀鸣嘶叫的兽群从你们周围奔腾而过，几双脚只差几英寸就会踩到你们的头。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 323
text: Off to one side, you spot a small geological formation. You drag Norman down behind it. The bleating, bawling stampede passes over and around you, several pairs of feet missing your heads by inches.
